routes.request: Create or review a resume or application packet
routes.target: Task decomposition and routing → Priya Desai · Job search orchestrator → Evidence-led Job Search Playbook
first_reads: docs/job-search/application-context-and-review.md: Local packet operation selects the designated-native-source route or suitable local-builder fallback

designated factual master/evidence and current private standing decisions; a source-bound candidate profile may carry verified facts, original passages and revisions; bootstrap or refresh only when needed
current employer posting and application requirements for each role
candidate-designated native editable source and formatting when provided; otherwise scripts/application-packet.py with the valid private profile and one role draft when the built-in layout fits
docs/playbooks/evidence-led-job-search.md only for campaign/exception guidance beyond routine packet production
docs/job-search/application-tracker-contract.md and the existing private tracker only when opportunity/application tracking is in scope, after file delivery
scripts/application-packet.mjs only when checkpointed native resume/Drive/Applications compatibility is needed; direct native editing/export also supports requested letters
Template catalog and verified rickvang/template-library source/revision only when using an external reusable Template
candidate-context-integration.md or resume-template-mapping.md only for unresolved candidate/source conflicts or external Template semantic mapping
docs/job-search/job-ledger-contract.md only when discovery/deduplication is in scope
docs/job-search/application-work-order-template.md only when unique execution/recovery state warrants it
non_triggers: Uploading, submitting, contacting an employer, or externally sharing without a separate explicit request
Claiming provider-specific rules without current evidence
Treating Riley Morgan as the Job Search Persona or sole domain expert
Storing private job-search history inside Persona-Library
Treating the Playbook itself as the actor or domain owner
Treating a full application packet as one combined document instead of separate role-folder artifacts
Using a private Drive master as the canonical reusable Template when template-library has not been checked and verified
Mixing evidence, standing decisions, voice rules, contact details, or validation overlays from different candidate contexts
Treating a cached profile as career authority or ignoring changed baseline facts/standing decisions; preserve source references and refresh conflicts
routes.next_handoff: Execute the routine packet path directly: resolve the designated factual master, current standing decisions and employer posting, then tailor one private editable resume and a separate letter when requested or required. Prefer the candidate-designated native source and formatting; export from that source. Use scripts/application-packet.py only when no native source is designated and its built-in layout fits, with one valid source-bound private profile and role draft. Produce one regular editable resume/PDF pair; extra ATS/DOCX variants require an actual format requirement, demonstrated need or explicit request. Review source meaning, role fit, candidate voice, chronology, Skills evidence and every final PDF page together; check text/order, links, unwanted attachments/actions and supplied tags/language, then deliver source/PDF links with the exact reviewed revision/file and limitations. Make corrections in the source and re-export. Unknown application answers do not block document production. Local checks do not establish employer ATS or live screen-reader behavior; use an actual Word-compatible renderer when DOCX is submitted. Bootstrap/refresh source context when missing, changed or conflicting. Template research, independent specialists, detailed notes and Work Orders are conditional. Application Entry separately owns authorized uploads, parsed-field repair, confirmed declarations and submission handoff. Tracking follows delivery when requested; resolve existing owner-scoped records, preserve later confirmed states and pending answers, and never infer Applied or submission dates. Priya owns full-outcome job-search orchestration; direct execution requires no extra runtime handoff. Preparation does not authorize submission, outreach or external sharing. For unqualified narrow requests, route directly to the matching specialist or Skill; unqualified full-outcome requests use Priya and the Playbook. Explicit specialist, Skill or Playbook requests route directly. The Playbook owns stages, shared state, quality gates, recovery and the learning loop. A valid candidate baseline projection preserves the career spine and standing decisions; secondary profile stores cannot replace unresolved authoritative sources. When tracking is in scope, resolve the existing tracker record by stable ID and sourceUrl before creating a duplicate; preserve source-backed postingDate, record packetUrl and honest Packet Ready only after review and required answers. Applied/appliedDate require confirmed submission; later states require confirmed events.
